sections.heading: Glossary term: Antimatter
sections.body: In the early 20th century, theoretical physicists realized that for every kind of particle there should be a corresponding kind of antiparticle – a particle with the same mass, but otherwise completely opposite properties, in particular opposite electric charge. A few years later, the antiparticle of the electron was discovered: The "positron" has the same mass as an electron, but opposite electric charge. For some neutral particles, like the photon, the antiparticle is the same as the particle. When particle and corresponding antiparticle meet, they can annihilate to form photons. Our Universe appears to be made mostly of matter, not of antimatter consisting of antiparticles. The details of how that came about are the subject of ongoing research.

Glossary term: Antimatter

Description: In the early 20th century, theoretical physicists realized that for every kind of particle there should be a corresponding kind of antiparticle – a particle with the same mass, but otherwise completely opposite properties, in particular opposite electric charge. A few years later, the antiparticle of the electron was discovered: The "positron" has the same mass as an electron, but opposite electric charge. For some neutral particles, like the photon, the antiparticle is the same as the particle. When particle and corresponding antiparticle meet, they can annihilate to form photons. Our Universe appears to be made mostly of matter, not of antimatter consisting of antiparticles. The details of how that came about are the subject of ongoing research.

Related Terms:

  • Matter
  • Particle
  • Particle Physics
  • Electron


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. sections.body_ru: В начале XX века физики-теоретики предсказали существование античастиц. У античастицы та же масса, что и у соответствующей частицы. Электрический заряд, если он есть, имеет противоположный знак. Через несколько лет открыли античастицу электрона — позитрон. Его масса равна массе электрона, а заряд противоположен. Некоторые нейтральные частицы, например фотон, совпадают со своими античастицами. При встрече частица и её античастица могут аннигилировать, образовав фотоны. По наблюдениям, во Вселенной преобладает обычное вещество, а антивещества, состоящего из античастиц, гораздо меньше. Причины такого неравенства продолжают изучать.

Related Media


The discovery of positron

Caption: This historic photograph shows the track of a positron moving through a cloud chamber from bottom to top. When a charged particle moves through a cloud chamber it leaves behind a line of condensation, making its path visible. Cloud chambers are normally build with magnetic fields. This curves the path of the charged particle, with the curve of the path giving more information about the properties of the particle. Here we see the first positron (the antiparticle of an electron). A thick horizontal band in the middle is a lead plate in the cloud chamber that slowed the particle down, causing the positron's path to curve more sharply after crossing the plate. This image, taken in 1932, provided the first clear visual evidence of the positron. The discovery of the positron confirmed that antimatter exists and opened an important field of research in modern physics.
Credit: Carl D. Anderson credit link

media.caption_en:
This historic photograph shows the track of a positron moving through a cloud chamber from bottom to top. When a charged particle moves through a cloud chamber it leaves behind a line of condensation, making its path visible. Cloud chambers are normally build with magnetic fields. This curves the path of the charged particle, with the curve of the path giving more information about the properties of the particle.

Here we see the first positron (the antiparticle of an electron). A thick horizontal band in the middle is a lead plate in the cloud chamber that slowed the particle down, causing the positron's path to curve more sharply after crossing the plate. This image, taken in 1932, provided the first clear visual evidence of the positron.

The discovery of the positron confirmed that antimatter exists and opened an important field of research in modern physics.
media.caption_ru:
На этом историческом снимке показан трек позитрона, движущегося через камеру Вильсона снизу вверх. Когда заряженная частица движется через камеру Вильсона, она оставляет за собой след из конденсации, делая свой путь видимым. Камеры Вильсона обычно строятся с магнитными полями. Это искривляет путь заряженной частицы, причем кривизна пути дает больше информации о свойствах частицы.

Здесь мы видим первый позитрон (античастицу электрона). Толстая горизонтальная полоса в середине — это свинцовая пластина в камере Вильсона, которая замедлила частицу, из-за чего путь позитрона после пересечения пластины стал искривляться сильнее. Этот снимок, сделанный в 1932, предоставил первое четкое визуальное доказательство существования позитрона.

Открытие позитрона подтвердило существование антиматерии и открыло важную область исследований в современной физике.
